shown_card_text.title: The window lights become Paris traffic lights
shown_card_text.what: The red, yellow and green window buttons pop off and turn into real traffic lights on a wet Paris street. It is one of the three Higgsfield shots you approved, made from our own graphics.
shown_card_text.why: You asked for more ambitious and fun generated shots, so this needs your eye.
shown_card_text.question: What should happen to this shot?
shown_card_text.recommendation: Opens a trio about tools you actually use. Its generated sound is dropped; the trio keeps our music.
context: All three shots together cost about a dollar forty, inside your monthly limit.
The month now reads about sixteen of your twenty dollars; nothing more is generating.

visual_input_policy: The exact first existing still/poster shown on the source card. It is one frame, not full video or audio.
